description: This Swift source file defines a persistent storage mechanism for push relay registration state and related keys, utilizing Keychain for secure storage. It includes data models, such as StoredPushRelayRegistrationState and RegistrationState, functions for loading, saving, and clearing registration data, as well as key IDs.

classes.name: StoredPushRelayRegistrationState
classes.description: A Codable struct that stores the persisted push relay registration data.

classes.name: PushRelayRegistrationStore
classes.description: A static utility enum providing methods for handling registration state and key IDs with secure storage.

methods.name: loadRegistrationState
methods.description: Retrieves the registration state from storage and decodes it.

methods.name: saveRegistrationState
methods.description: Encodes and saves the provided registration state to storage.

methods.name: clearRegistrationState
methods.description: Deletes the registration state from storage.

methods.name: loadAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Loads the App Attest Key ID from secure storage.

methods.name: saveAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Saves the App Attest Key ID to secure storage.

methods.name: clearAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Clears the App Attest Key ID from storage.

methods.name: loadAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Loads the Attested Key ID from storage.

methods.name: saveAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Saves the Attested Key ID to storage.

methods.name: clearAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Removes the Attested Key ID from storage.
